title: Use external URL for all PWA home-screen icon sizes

requirements.text:
Update the PWA manifest icons so that all home-screen icon entries (192x192, 512x512, and maskable 512x512) use the provided external image URL as their `src` value instead of local `/assets/generated/...` paths.

External image URL (use exactly as provided):
https://blob.caffeine.ai/v1/blob/?blob_hash=sha256%3A5e8468951155e9387499978e83162188afd39a6d2ce119a1b96650eded40facf&owner_id=bjzp7-xyaaa-aaaaf-qbsta-cai&project_id=0198d89b-d4eb-711d-abfd-9b50202a1152
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest` has three icon entries (192x192, 512x512 any, 512x512 maskable) whose `src` is the provided external URL.
No remaining `/assets/generated/pwa-icon...` references exist in the manifest `icons` array.
After building and loading the app, the manifest served by the app reflects the updated icon `src` values.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep the change limited to PWA home-screen icons in the web manifest; do not introduce new backend services or external dependencies.
nonGoals: Do not change favicon (`/assets/generated/favicon.dim_32x32.png`) or Apple touch icon (`/assets/generated/apple-touch-icon.dim_180x180.png`) in `frontend/index.html` unless explicitly requested.
Do not redesign UI/branding beyond updating the manifest icon sources.
Do not add a new authentication method (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
